findings.diagnosis: BIG, 'Improve account access', is estimated at 6 days and combines a three-day session-token verifier with an independent three-day account-recovery UI. Keeping them together exceeds the 1-3 day target and delays shipping either concern until both are complete.
findings.recommended_action: Propose two independently shippable tickets: the session-token verifier and the account-recovery UI, each estimated at three days.
